clips.title: Chef idle
clips.description: Breathing, small head turns and relaxed paws.

clips.title: Walking
clips.description: In-place gait with short steps and opposing arm swings.

clips.title: Dash burst
clips.description: Anticipation, forward lean, fast feet and recovery. Travel shown here is a preview.

clips.title: Hold a plate
clips.description: Two paws support a level plate with a quiet breathing loop.

clips.title: Walk with a plate
clips.description: A walking cycle with the plate kept level between the paws.

clips.title: Throw an ingredient
clips.description: Wind-up, release, ingredient arc over the rail and follow-through.

clips.title: Chop a tomato
clips.description: Three knife strokes, then the same ingredient changes to its chopped state.

clips.title: Wash a dirty plate
clips.description: Scrubbing with a sponge, then the same dish becomes clean and is picked up.

clips.title: Fight a kitchen fire
clips.description: Hold, aim and spray. Flames shrink and stop; the food stays burnt.

clips.title: Seated customer idle
clips.description: Seated breathing, gentle looking around and small arm shifts.

clips.title: Customer eating
clips.description: A slow bite gesture and a head bob, returning to a resting pose.

clips.title: Overcooking → fire
clips.description: Accelerated review: cooking, ready, warning smoke, then ignition.
